Question Choices: Fill. The number 428351 rounded to the nearest hundred is __.
Hints: Find the rounding place. Inspect the next digit to its right; 5 or more rounds up, and 0 through 4 rounds down.
Solution: The neighboring multiples of 100 are 428300 and 428400. Distances: 428351 - 428300 = 51; 428400 - 428351 = 49. The rounded result is 428400. Write zeros in all places to the right of the rounding place.

Question Choices: Select which of the following digits could replace the _ in the hundreds place to make this statement true? 312,_45 rounds to 313,000 if we round to the nearest thousand: ~~3 | 6 | 8 | 2~~
Hints: Determine whether the required result needs rounding up or down, then check every offered digit.
Solution: To round 312,_45 up to 313000, the hundreds digit must be 5 through 9. Among 3, 6, 8 and 2, select 6 and 8.

Question Choices: Select which of these numbers rounds to 800,000 when rounded to the nearest 100,000?: ~~745999 | 850000 | 821456~~
Hints: Find the rounding place. Inspect the next digit to its right; 5 or more rounds up, and 0 through 4 rounds down.
Solution: 745999 rounds to 700000; the halfway number 850000 rounds up to 900000; 821456 rounds to 800000. Select 821456.

Question Choices: A library has 145,829 books in its collection. The head librarian wants to round this number to the nearest thousand for a community newsletter. What number will appear in the newsletter?
Hints: Find the rounding place. Inspect the next digit to its right; 5 or more rounds up, and 0 through 4 rounds down.
Solution: The neighboring multiples of 1000 are 145000 and 146000. Distances: 145829 - 145000 = 829; 146000 - 145829 = 171. The rounded result is 146000. Write zeros in all places to the right of the rounding place.

Question Choices: A local stadium had an attendance of 52,491 over the weekend. For the official sports report, the attendance needs to be rounded to the nearest ten thousand. What rounded number should the reporter use?
Hints: Find the rounding place. Inspect the next digit to its right; 5 or more rounds up, and 0 through 4 rounds down.
Solution: The neighboring multiples of 10000 are 50000 and 60000. Distances: 52491 - 50000 = 2491; 60000 - 52491 = 7509. The rounded result is 50000. Write zeros in all places to the right of the rounding place.
